### Day 54: 2 Samuel 10:1–19
Author: Beth Moore
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/plus/books/portraits-of-devotion/portraits-of-devotion-day-54-2-samuel-10-119.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 10:2
Points:
- David mirrored God's compassionate character by sending delegates to comfort a newly crowned neighbor mourning his father.
- Hanun embraced cynical advice that misconstrued David's sincere kindness as a hostile plot to overthrow the city.
- Hanun stripped the delegates of their dignity by shaving half their beards and exposing them, just as humanity rejected and humiliated Jesus on the cross.
- David demonstrated protective care by sending the humiliated men to Jericho until their beards regrew rather than parading their shame.
- Believers can take comfort knowing God personally defends His people and will vindicate those who suffer disgrace while obeying Him.
